item.name: 003 SELECT: estado antes del rechazo (solicitudes, archivos, eventos, notificaciones)

body.raw: {"query": "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM modulo8.solicitudes_reportes WHERE id_usuario IN ({{id_user_productor}}, {{id_user_contador}})) AS solicitudes, (SELECT count(*) FROM modulo8.archivos_reportes a JOIN modulo8.solicitudes_reportes s ON s.id_solicitud_reporte = a.id_solicitud_reporte WHERE s.id_usuario IN ({{id_user_productor}}, {{id_user_contador}})) AS archivos, (SELECT count(*) FROM modulo1.eventos WHERE modulo = 'MODULO8' AND id_usuario IN ({{id_user_productor}}, {{id_user_contador}})) AS eventos, (SELECT count(*) FROM modulo1.notificaciones WHERE id_usuario IN ({{id_user_productor}}, {{id_user_contador}})) AS notificaciones"}
